subject: Amplitude: costline itemization & migration timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Amplitude renewal — need clean line items + migration plan

Team — quick status and asks before we engage procurement next week. I spoke with Samira at Amplitude this morning; they've sent a revised quote but the proposal bundles a mixture of product and API analytics usage under a single recurring SKU which makes it hard to compare against our current Split between instrumentation (Segment) and event storage/analysis (Amplitude).

As a result we need three things from them before we escalate to procurement:
- A clear line-item spreadsheet showing seat vs MAU vs data retention charges (per-environment if possible).
- An explicit map of which current Segment events will be considered "ingested" vs "forwarded" (affects ingress fees) — attach Segment mapping doc for them to fill.
- A firm migration timeline that allows us to run a parallel ingest for 60 days during switch-over.

Action: Laura, can you own the line-item review and call out any cost buckets that look unexpected? Karthik, please draft a short procurement ask (SOW changes + term request) that we can hand to finance by 07/27. Marissa, can you confirm whether CS wants any retention >24 months baked in; that will materially change the quote.

I'll take point on the call with Amplitude tomorrow at 11:00 PT and push for the XLS. I've attached the Segment event map we want them to complete and the initial quote they sent.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: segment_migration_map_v1.docx, amplitude_quote_v1.pdf
From: Samira Khan <skhan@amplitude.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@amplitude.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Amplitude renewal — cost breakdown and migration options

Hi Aditya / Laura — thanks for the call this morning. Attaching the updated line-item spreadsheet (amplitude_line_item_breakdown.xlsx) and a short SOW draft that reflects the 60-day parallel ingest window you requested. High level notes:

- We split charges into: Core Platform (monthly), MAU overage bands, Event Ingest (per 1M events), Retention tiers (30/90/365/730 days), and Enterprise Features (feature flags, experimentation).
- For your Segment-forwarded events: we mark them as "forward-only" where Amplitude is not the primary system of record; those are excluded from storage fees but still count towards processing until forwarded.
- We can commit to a two-week migration pilot followed by 60 days parallel ingest at no extra SOW cost if you accept a 12-month term extension and the quoted MAU bands.

I've highlighted three line items where we can provide a temporary credit: first 90 days of ingest fees for forward-only events, environment-level discount for dev/staging, and a one-time migration engineering credit ($12k).

Please review and let me know which of the credits you want me to push to Contracts. I copied Contracts so they can prepare a redline-ready agreement if you confirm terms.

Best,
Samira Khan
Enterprise Sales, Amplitude

Attachments: amplitude_line_item_breakdown.xlsx, SOW-redwood-amplitude-draft.pdf

On Wed, Jul 22, 2026 at 10:45 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — speak shortly.
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@amplitude.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Amplitude: costline itemization & migration timeline

Samira — thanks, the XLS looks a lot cleaner. A few clarifying items from our side after a quick pass:

1) Retention tiers: please split retention costs into a pure storage line and a separate query/compute line. We need to attribute compute costs to product analytics usage vs. ad-hoc data science runs.
2) For forwarded events: define "processing" vs "ingestion" precisely (i.e., does Amplitude run transforms that would increase CPU cost before forwarding?).
3) Migration pilot: we want the 60-day parallel ingest to include traffic shaping so we can validate tail-latency and bucketed retention before cutting over.

If Amplitude can accept those three items, we can sign-off on sending to Contracts. Also: Karthik — procurement will want the one-time migration credit formalized in the SOW and the MAU bands guaranteed for 12 months. Please flag any SOW language you need us to adjust.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Platform Analytics
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Contracts <contracts@amplitude.com>, Samira Khan <skhan@amplitude.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Procurement ask: SOW redlines + billing cadence request (RDW-AMP-2026-07)

Hi Samira / Contracts team — looping in procurement formally. We're prepared to proceed conditional on three contract items:

1) Explicit line items for: ingest (per 1M events), storage (GB/mo), query/compute (hourly or query-unit), and enterprise features (flat fee). No blended "platform+ingest" buckets.
2) A 12-month MAU band guarantee with defined overage bands and a 30-day notice window for any band adjustments.
3) Migration SOW that includes: a two-week pilot, 60-day parallel ingest, migration runbook, rollback plan, and a $12,000 migration credit incorporated into the SOW.

Also confirm billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether Credits will be applied as invoice-level credits or back-billed adjustments. For budgeting we need an invoice schedule by Aug 5 so Finance can create the PO.

Please attach a redline of the SOW and the updated quote showing applied credits.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <skhan@amplitude.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts <contracts@amplitude.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: updated quote + SOW ready for redline (AMP-5231)

Folks — per our conversations attached is the final quote (amplitude_quote_v2.pdf) and SOW draft that incorporate the items Karthik requested. Summary of changes included:

- Line-itemized pricing: ingest, storage, compute, enterprise features.
- 12-month MAU band guarantee + defined overage pricing and a 30-day adjustment clause.
- Migration SOW updated with a two-week pilot, 60-day parallel ingest, and a rollback plan. Migration engineering credit ($12k) applied as an invoice credit on the first invoice post-cutover.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices with Net 30 terms (we can move to quarterly invoicing with 5% admin fee if you'd prefer).

Next steps: if you confirm we will produce a redline-ready contract in DocuSign and route to Contracts. Please confirm by EOD Aug 5 so we can preserve quoted MAU bands and pilot credits.

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to run through the XLS together.

Best,
Samira Khan
Enterprise Sales, Amplitude

Attachments: amplitude_quote_v2.pdf, SOW-redwood-amplitude-draft.pdf
